_comment: Copy to config.json, or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path. Database, skill directory and the fixed English presentation locale are supported; configure LLM providers through the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ARTEX_PG_DSN overrides this object. Supply individual fields or a complete database.dsn. Local plaintext database transport is for a private development network only.
_comment_database_dsn: Alternative: replace database with a nonempty dsn; individual fields are then ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root: one directory containing SKILL.md per skill. ARTEX_SKILL_DIR overrides this value; otherwise the default is skills/ beside the executable. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
_comment_language: This edition supports English only. Other saved language preferences resolve to English.
